mentions.name: SaludPass
mentions.description: A personal health record web app that keeps allergies, medications, and medical documents in one place and lets users share them with any doctor in seconds via a QR code or link. Data is stored in Google Drive (a Gmail account is required), and the app is currently available only in Spanish.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://saludpass.com one place for allergies, medications, and documents. Share it with any doctor in seconds—with a QR code or a link, data is saved in gdrive, therefore it requires a gmail account, at this moment only in spanish.
mentions.author: chilicuil
